# Changelog

The full history is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/s00d/onlinesim-ruby-api/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}.

## 2.1.1

- `wait_code` retries `TRY_AGAIN_LATER` (rate limit), `ERROR_UNDEFINED` and `INTERVAL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS_ERROR`.
- `payment_history["paylist"]` is kept when it arrives as a list; error messages follow the current API.
- `MockOnlineSim` follows the backend more closely: rent reservation and confirmation, `setOperationRevise` and `closeRentNum` answers, missing vs wrong key — see [Testing](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-ruby-api/testing).

## 2.1.0

- New: `OnlineSim::MockOnlineSim`, an offline fake of the API for your tests — see [Testing](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-ruby-api/testing).

## 2.0.0

A rewrite with a new API; v1 code does not run unchanged.

- One client, `OnlineSim::Client.new(api_key:)`, with the sections as readers: `client.numbers`, `client.rent`, `client.user`, `client.free`.
- Zero runtime dependencies (`Net::HTTP` + `JSON`), Ruby 3.0+. TLS is verified (v1 disabled verification globally).
- The key is sent as a Bearer header, never in the URL.
- Typed errors: `ApiError`, `NoNumberError`, `TransportError`, `TimeoutError`.
- `numbers.wait_code` waits for a real SMS: interval and timeout in seconds, `keep_open:`, `since:`, retries network errors.
- `rent.get` creates extendable rents by default (`extension: true`); `rent.extend` takes `days`.
- New: `user.set_webhook_url` / `clear_webhook_url` / `webhook_logs`, `OnlineSim.parse_webhook`.
- Removed: the proxy API, the forward API, the `onlinesim` CLI, `numbers.service` / `service_number`, `rent.port_reload`, `free.countries` / `numbers` / `messages` (use `free.list`).


# Free numbers

## list

Countries, the numbers of the selected country and the SMS of the selected number, in one call.

```ruby
list(country: nil, number: nil, page: nil, count: nil) # => Hash
```

| Option     | Type      | Default        | Description                                                      |
| ---------- | --------- | -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `country:` | `Integer` | `44` (server)  | Country code; an unknown one falls back to the first available.  |
| `number:`  | `String`  | first number   | Number **without** the country code, as the keys of `"numbers"`. |
| `page:`    | `Integer` | `1`            | Page of `"messages"`.                                            |
| `count:`   | `Integer` | server default | SMS per page, 10–500.                                            |

Result:

- `"countries"`: `[{"country", "country_text", "country_original"}]`
- `"numbers"`: `{short_number => {"country", "country_original", "full_number", "data_humans", "is_archive"}}`
- `"messages"`: a paginator of `{"id", "text", "in_number", "my_number", "code", "created_at", "data_humans"}` plus `"number"` and `"country"`; `code` is `-` when no code was found

```ruby
numbers = client.free.list(country: 44)["numbers"]
short = numbers.keys.first
if short
  messages = client.free.list(country: 44, number: short, count: 20)["messages"]
  messages["data"].each { |sms| puts sms.values_at("in_number", "code", "text").join(" ") }
end
```


# Numbers

An operation (`tzid`) is one ordered number. Order it with `get`/`get_with_number`, read the SMS with `state_one` or `wait_code`, finish it with `close` (or `ban`). Countries are phone codes (`7`, `44`, …), services are slugs (`google`, `vkcom`, …) as returned by `tariffs`.

## price

Price of one number, USD; `nil` when the country has no price for the service.

```ruby
price(service, country = 7) # => Float or nil
```

| Param     | Type      | Default | Description   |
| --------- | --------- | ------- | ------------- |
| `service` | `String`  | —       | Service slug. |
| `country` | `Integer` | `7`     | Country code. |

```ruby
usd = client.numbers.price("google", 44)
```

Errors: `ApiError` `ERROR_NO_SERVICE`, `UNDEFINED_COUNTRY`.

## get

Order a number; returns the operation id. Freezes the price on the balance.

```ruby
get(service, country = 7, reject: nil) # => Integer (tzid)
```

| Param     | Type      | Default      | Description                               |
| --------- | --------- | ------------ | ----------------------------------------- |
| `service` | `String`  | —            | Service slug.                             |
| `country` | `Integer` | `7`          | Country code.                             |
| `reject:` | `Array`   | profile list | Number prefixes to skip, e.g. `["4470"]`. |

```ruby
tzid = client.numbers.get("google", 44, reject: ["4470"])
```

Errors: `NoNumberError`; `ApiError` `WARNING_LOW_BALANCE`, `ERROR_NO_SERVICE`, `UNDEFINED_COUNTRY`, `EXCEEDED_CONCURRENT_OPERATIONS`, `INTERVAL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS_ERROR`, `TRY_AGAIN_LATER`.

## get_with_number

Same as `get`, but returns the number right away.

```ruby
get_with_number(service, country = 7, reject: nil) # => Hash
```

Returns `{"tzid", "number", "country", "time", "service", "title"?, "guard_interval_remaining_seconds"?}` — `number` with `+`, `time` in seconds left.

```ruby
order = client.numbers.get_with_number("google", 44)
puts order["number"]
```

Errors: as `get`.

## state

All operations of the account; `[]` when there are none.

```ruby
state(message_to_code: true, order_by: "asc", msg_list: false) # => Array of Hash
```

| Option             | Type              | Default | Description                                          |
| ------------------ | ----------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `message_to_code:` | `Boolean`         | `true`  | `msg` is the code only; `false` — the full SMS text. |
| `order_by:`        | `"asc"`, `"desc"` | `"asc"` | Order of operations.                                 |
| `msg_list:`        | `Boolean`         | `false` | `msg` is a list of all SMS (`[{"service", "msg"}]`). |

An operation: `{"tzid", "response", "number"?, "service"?, "country"?, "sum"?, "time"?, "msg"?, "guard_interval_remaining_seconds"?, …}`.
`response` is the state: `TZ_INPOOL` (number being assigned), `TZ_NUM_WAIT` (waiting for SMS), `TZ_NUM_ANSWER` (SMS arrived), `TZ_OVER_OK` (finished), `ERROR_NO_ITEMS` (failed). `msg` is absent until the first SMS. The server caches answers for a few seconds.

```ruby
client.numbers.state(order_by: "desc").each do |op|
  puts [op["tzid"], op["response"], op["msg"]].join(" ")
end
```

## state_one

One operation.

```ruby
state_one(tzid, message_to_code: true, msg_list: false) # => Hash
```

```ruby
op = client.numbers.state_one(tzid)
puts op["msg"] if op["response"] == "TZ_NUM_ANSWER"
```

Errors: `ApiError` `ERROR_NO_OPERATIONS` when the operation does not exist (any more).

## wait_code

Poll the operation until a code arrives, then close it and return the code.

```ruby
wait_code(tzid, interval: 5, timeout: 600, keep_open: false, full_message: false, since: nil) # => String
```

| Option           | Type            | Default                         | Description                                                          |
| ---------------- | --------------- | ------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `interval:`      | `Numeric`       | `5`                             | Poll interval, seconds.                                              |
| `timeout:`       | `Numeric`       | `600`                           | Give up after, seconds.                                              |
| `keep_open:`     | `Boolean`       | `false`                         | Call `next(tzid)` instead of `close(tzid)`, to wait for another SMS. |
| `full_message:`  | `Boolean`       | `false`                         | Return the full SMS text instead of the code.                        |
| `since:`         | `String`, `nil` | `nil`                           | Ignore this value (the previous code).                               |
| `sleep:`, `now:` | callables       | `Kernel#sleep`, monotonic clock | Injectable for tests (seconds).                                      |

Transient errors are retried until the timeout: `TransportError`, and `ApiError` `TRY_AGAIN_LATER` (the HTTP 429 rate limit), `ERROR_UNDEFINED` and `INTERVAL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS_ERROR`. Any other `ApiError` is raised at once. Also available as `OnlineSim.wait_code(numbers, tzid, **options)`.

```ruby
first = client.numbers.wait_code(tzid, keep_open: true)
second = client.numbers.wait_code(tzid, since: first)
```

Errors: `TimeoutError`; `ApiError` with code `TZ_OVER_OK` or `ERROR_NO_ITEMS` when the operation ended without a new code; any other `ApiError` from `state_one`/`close`/`next`.

## next

Switch the operation to its next SMS and keep it open (for services that send several SMS).

```ruby
next(tzid) # => true
```

```ruby
client.numbers.next(tzid)
```

Errors: `ApiError` `ERROR_WRONG_TZID` (not an operation of your account), `ERROR_NO_TZID`.

## close

Finish the operation. An operation without SMS can be closed only after its guard interval (`guard_interval_remaining_seconds`); every attempt locks the tzid for 5 s.

```ruby
close(tzid) # => true
```

```ruby
client.numbers.close(tzid)
```

Errors: `ApiError` `NO_COMPLETE_TZID`, `INTERVAL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS_ERROR`, `ERROR_WRONG_TZID`.

## ban

Finish the operation and report the number as bad. Only before any SMS arrived.

```ruby
ban(tzid) # => true
```

```ruby
client.numbers.ban(tzid)
```

Errors: as `close`; `ApiError` with code `"0"` when the operation already has an SMS — nothing is changed then.

## tariffs

Services, prices and stock of every country, keyed by country code (a `String`). No API key needed. The answer is large (a few MB); prefer `tariffs_one`.

```ruby
tariffs # => Hash of country code => Hash
```

A country: `{"name", "locale_name"?, "position", "code", "other"?, "new", "enabled", "services"}`; `services` maps `service_<slug>` to `{"count", "popular", "code", "price", "id", "service", "slug"}`.

```ruby
all = client.numbers.tariffs
puts "#{all.size} countries"
```

## tariffs_one

Services, prices and stock of one country.

```ruby
tariffs_one(country = 7) # => Hash
```

```ruby
uk = client.numbers.tariffs_one(44)
uk["services"].each_value { |s| puts [s["slug"], s["price"], s["count"]].join(" ") }
```

Errors: `ApiError` `NO_COUNTRY`.


# Rent

A rent keeps a number for `days` days. Its SMS come in `"messages"`, newest first.

`get` reserves the price (it shows in `zbalance`): the rent starts with `status` `0` and `checked` `false` and waits up to 20 minutes for its first SMS. The first SMS that is not a `notify` notice confirms it (`status` `1`) and charges the price; without one the rent closes and the reservation is released. Some countries (`confirm` in `tariffs`, e.g. US numbers) are confirmed and charged at once.

A rent item: `{"tzid", "status", "number", "country", "sum", "days", "hours", "time", "time_seconds"?, "extension", "extend", "messages", "start_time", "stop_time", "day_extend"?, …}` —
`sum` is the cost in USD incl. extensions (a `Float`; `rent.state` gets it from the server as a decimal string), `time` minutes left, `time_seconds` seconds left,
`extension` `0` not extendable / `1` extendable / `2` auto-extension, `extend` maps days to the extension price (`{}` when not extendable),
`messages` is a list of `{"id", "service", "text", "code", "created_at"}` — `code` is `""` when no code was found and the `Integer` `0` for a `notify` SMS (a prohibited sender).

## get

Rent a number. The price is reserved; the first SMS charges it.

```ruby
get(country = 7, days = 1, extension: true) # => Hash
```

| Param        | Type      | Default | Description                                     |
| ------------ | --------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `country`    | `Integer` | `7`     | Country code.                                   |
| `days`       | `Integer` | `1`     | One of the tariff's `days` keys.                |
| `extension:` | `Boolean` | `true`  | `false` makes the rent non-extendable for good. |

```ruby
rent = client.rent.get(7, 7)
puts rent.values_at("tzid", "number", "sum").join(" ")
```

Errors: `NoNumberError`; `ApiError` `UNDEFINED_DAYS`, `UNDEFINED_COUNTRY`, `WARNING_LOW_BALANCE`, `INTERVAL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS_ERROR`, `TRY_AGAIN_LATER`.

## state

All rents of the account.

```ruby
state # => Array of Hash
```

```ruby
client.rent.state.each do |rent|
  puts "#{rent['number']} #{rent['messages'].first&.fetch('code')}"
end
```

## state_one

One rent.

```ruby
state_one(tzid) # => Hash
```

```ruby
messages = client.rent.state_one(tzid)["messages"]
```

Errors: `ApiError` `ERROR_NO_OPERATIONS` for an unknown tzid.

## extend

Extend a rent by `days` days and charge the balance at once. Only confirmed rents (`status` `1` or `4`) created with `extension: true`.

```ruby
extend(tzid, days = 1) # => Hash
```

```ruby
rent = client.rent.extend(tzid, 3)
puts rent["stop_time"]
```

Errors: `ApiError` `TRY_AGAIN_LATER` (unknown tzid, not confirmed yet or closed, not extendable, unknown period, a repeat within 10 s), `WARNING_LOW_BALANCE`.

## close

Return the number before the period ends. A rent that is not confirmed yet (`status` `0`) and has no SMS can be closed only after 120 s; then, or with only `notify` SMS, the reservation is released. With a real SMS the rent is confirmed (charged) and closed. A confirmed rent closes without a refund. US numbers cannot be closed early.

```ruby
close(tzid) # => true
```

```ruby
client.rent.close(tzid)
```

Errors: `ApiError` `ERROR_NO_OPERATIONS`, `NO_COMPLETE_TZID`, `NO_CLOSE_RENT_US`, `TRY_AGAIN_LATER`.

## tariffs

Rent prices of every country, keyed by country code (a `String`). No API key needed.

```ruby
tariffs # => Hash of country code => Hash
```

A tariff: `{"code", "name", "enabled", "new", "position", "extend", "confirm"?, "days", "count", "ext_counts"?}` — `days` maps rent days to the price in USD, `count` to the numbers available.

```ruby
tariffs = client.rent.tariffs
```

## tariffs_one

Rent prices of one country.

```ruby
tariffs_one(country = 7) # => Hash
```

```ruby
days = client.rent.tariffs_one(7)["days"]
puts days["7"] # price of 7 days
```

Errors: `ApiError` `NO_COUNTRY` for a country without rent.


# Testing

`OnlineSim::MockOnlineSim` is an in-process fake of the OnlineSim API that ships with the gem. It is a transport that answers like the real backend — same shapes, same error codes, HTTP 456 for a wrong key — and keeps a balance, operations and rents. Your code talks to a normal `OnlineSim::Client`, so nothing in it changes for tests. It is deterministic: no randomness, no clock, numbers and ids come from a counter.

## Setup

```ruby
require "onlinesim" # MockOnlineSim is autoloaded on first use; `require "onlinesim/mock"` works too

mock = OnlineSim::MockOnlineSim.new(balance: 10)
client = mock.client # an OnlineSim::Client wired to the mock
```

```ruby
OnlineSim::MockOnlineSim.new(api_key: "mock-key", balance: 100, prices: nil, rent_tariffs: nil, guard_interval: 0)
```

| Option           | Default                                                                                                       | Description                                                                                                     |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `api_key`        | `"mock-key"`                                                                                                  | Key the mock accepts. `mock.client` uses it; `mock.client(api_key: "x")` tests a wrong key.                     |
| `balance`        | `100`                                                                                                         | Starting balance, USD.                                                                                          |
| `prices`         | `{ 7 => { "vkcom" => 0.5, "telegram" => 1.2, "google" => 0.3 }, 44 => { "google" => 0.2, "vkcom" => 0.36 } }` | Number prices, country code → service slug → USD; replaces the defaults. Also feeds `numbers.tariffs`.          |
| `rent_tariffs`   | `{ 7 => { days: { 1 => 1.0, 3 => 2.5, 7 => 5.0 }, extend: 1 } }`                                              | Rent prices; `extend: 0` makes rents of that country non-extendable.                                            |
| `guard_interval` | `0`                                                                                                           | `> 0`: an operation without SMS, or an unconfirmed rent without any SMS, cannot be closed (`NO_COMPLETE_TZID`). |

`mock.client(**options)` takes the usual [client options](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-ruby-api/#client-options) except `transport:`. To build the client yourself, pass `mock.transport` (the mock itself) as `transport:`; any `base_url` works:

```ruby
mock = OnlineSim::MockOnlineSim.new
client = OnlineSim::Client.new(api_key: "mock-key", transport: mock.transport)
```

## A full example

Order a number, let an SMS arrive while `wait_code` polls, check the code and the money. `add_sms_after` delivers the SMS after a number of polls instead of after some time, so `wait_code` runs with `interval: 0` and the test takes milliseconds.

```ruby
require "minitest/autorun"
require "onlinesim"

class ReceiveCodeTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_receives_the_code
    mock = OnlineSim::MockOnlineSim.new(balance: 10)
    client = mock.client

    order = client.numbers.get_with_number("google", 44)
    assert_equal "+44900000001", order["number"]

    mock.add_sms_after(order["tzid"], "Your Google code: 123-456", 2) # the third poll sees it
    code = client.numbers.wait_code(order["tzid"], interval: 0)

    assert_equal "123456", code
    assert_equal "TZ_OVER_OK", mock.operations.first.status # wait_code closed it
    assert_in_delta 9.8, mock.balance # the price is spent once an SMS arrived
  end
end
```

The `msg` of an operation is the code by default: the first run of 4–8 digits, with spaces and dashes between digits removed (`123-456` → `123456`); a text without such a run comes back whole. `message_to_code: false` (or `full_message: true` in `wait_code`) gives the full text.

## Errors

`fail_next(code)` makes the next request answer `{"response": code}` — the client turns it into `ApiError` (or `NoNumberError`) exactly as for the real server. Pass `endpoint:` to fail only that endpoint. `fail_next_transport` makes the next request fail with a non-JSON HTTP 502 (`TransportError`).

```ruby
def test_handles_a_missing_number_and_a_network_hiccup
  mock = OnlineSim::MockOnlineSim.new
  client = mock.client

  mock.fail_next("NO_NUMBER", endpoint: "getNum.php")
  assert_raises(OnlineSim::NoNumberError) { client.numbers.get("google") }

  mock.fail_next_transport(status: 503)
  assert_raises(OnlineSim::TransportError) { client.user.balance }

  assert_in_delta 100, client.user.balance["balance"] # one-shot
end
```

The state itself produces the real error codes too: `WARNING_LOW_BALANCE` when the balance is short, `NO_NUMBER` when `reject` matches the next number, `UNDEFINED_COUNTRY` / `ERROR_NO_SERVICE` for unknown prices, `ERROR_WRONG_TZID` for an unknown or closed operation (`next` too; `ERROR_NO_TZID` for tzid `0`), `UNDEFINED_COUNTRY` / `UNDEFINED_DAYS` for an unknown rent country or period, `TRY_AGAIN_LATER` for every refused `rent.extend`, `ERROR_NO_OPERATIONS` for an unknown rent in `rent.close`, `ERROR_WRONG_KEY` for a wrong key (HTTP 456) or no key (HTTP 200).

## Inspecting requests

`mock.requests` lists every request received as `{ method:, path:, query:, body: }`: `path` relative to `/api/`, `query` with String keys and values, `body` the parsed JSON of a POST (`nil` for GET).

```ruby
def test_sends_reject_as_a_comma_list
  mock = OnlineSim::MockOnlineSim.new
  mock.client.numbers.get("google", 44, reject: %w[4470 4471])

  assert_equal [{ method: "GET", path: "getNum.php",
                  query: { "service" => "google", "country" => "44", "reject" => "4470,4471", "lang" => "en" },
                  body: nil }], mock.requests
end
```

## Control API

| Member                                            | Description                                                                                                                             |
| ------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `client(**options)`                               | A normal `OnlineSim::Client` wired to the mock.                                                                                         |
| `transport`                                       | The mock itself (it implements `call(method, url, headers, body, timeout)`).                                                            |
| `add_sms(tzid, text, service: nil)`               | An SMS arrives now at a number operation or a rent (detected by `tzid`). Raises `ArgumentError` for an unknown or closed one.           |
| `add_sms_after(tzid, text, polls, service: nil)`  | The SMS arrives after `polls` state requests for `tzid` (`numbers.state`/`state_one`, `rent.state`/`state_one`).                        |
| `fail_next(code, endpoint: nil)`                  | The next request (to `endpoint` only, e.g. `"getNum.php"`) answers `{"response": code}`.                                                |
| `fail_next_transport(status: 502, endpoint: nil)` | The next request fails with a non-JSON body and HTTP `status`.                                                                          |
| `set_balance(usd)` / `balance`                    | Set / read the total balance, USD (it includes the part frozen by open operations and unconfirmed rents, as `user.balance` reports it). |
| `operations` / `rents`                            | Copies of the current number operations / open rents (`Struct`s: `tzid`, `status`, `messages`, …), for assertions.                      |
| `requests`                                        | Log of the requests received (a copy).                                                                                                  |
| `reset`                                           | Back to the constructor's state.                                                                                                        |

## What the mock does

- **Numbers**: `get` freezes the price; `close` after an SMS spends it, `close` without one refunds it; `ban` after an SMS answers `"0"`, like the server. Numbers are `+<country>9000000NN`, ids count from 1. `next` switches to the following SMS. The operation's `time` stays at 1200 s — there is no clock.
- **Rent**: `get` reserves the price (`status` `0`, `checked` `false`) and keeps the `extension` flag; the first SMS that is not `notify` confirms the rent (`status` `1`) and charges it — `add_sms(tzid, text, service: "notify")` adds a notice with `code` `0` that confirms nothing. `extend` works on a confirmed rent and charges at once. `close` releases the reservation of an unconfirmed rent and gives no refund for a confirmed one. `sum` is a number in `get`/`extend` and a decimal string on the wire of `state`, like the server. SMS appear in `messages`, newest first.
- **User**: `balance` (frozen part included), a fixed profile, `set_webhook_url` accepts any `scheme://…` URL (`VALIDATION_ERROR` otherwise), `webhook_logs` lists the deliveries the mock *recorded* when an SMS arrived while a webhook URL was set — it makes no HTTP call; their `params` follow the real payload (`code` `""` without a code, rent `number` in digits without `+`, rent `time_left` in minutes). `payment_history` has no orders.
- **Free**: `free.list` returns two fixed countries (44 first) with one number and a few SMS each.
- Not imitated: anything that needs real time — the 5 s lock after `setOperationOk` (`INTERVAL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS_ERROR`), the 10 s lock of `rent.extend`, the 120 s before an unconfirmed rent may be closed and its 20-minute wait for the first SMS. `guard_interval > 0` stands in for "too early to close".


# User

## balance

Balance in USD.

```ruby
balance # => {"balance" => Float, "zbalance" => Float, "income" => Float (when sent)}
```

`balance` includes the sum frozen by numbers and unconfirmed rents in progress (`zbalance`, which may be negative): available = `balance − max(zbalance, 0)`. `income` is the partner income. The server caches the answer for 60 s.

```ruby
b = client.user.balance
available = b["balance"] - [b["zbalance"], 0].max
```

Errors: `ApiError` `ERROR_WRONG_KEY`, `ACCOUNT_BLOCKED`, `API_ACCESS_DISABLED`, `API_ACCESS_IP`.

## profile

The account profile.

```ruby
profile # => Hash
```

Profile: `{"id", "name", "username", "email", "locale", "currency", "number_country", "number_reject", "webhook_url", "api_access", …}`.

```ruby
profile = client.user.profile
puts profile.values_at("email", "webhook_url").join(" ")
```

## payment_history

Top-up orders (paginated, newest first) and the available payment methods.

```ruby
payment_history(page = 1) # => Hash
```

`{"orders" => paginator, "paylist", "domains"?, "forms"?, "currency"?, "buttons"?}`. An order's `sum` stays a decimal string (`"89.00"`); `currency` and `form_text` may be `nil`. `paylist` maps a group id to its payment methods, or is an `Array` when the ids are 0, 1, 2… (the server sends a JSON array then).

```ruby
orders = client.user.payment_history["orders"]
puts "#{orders['total']} orders, page #{orders['current_page']}/#{orders['last_page']}"
```

## set_webhook_url

Set the URL that receives SMS webhooks (see [Webhooks](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-ruby-api/webhooks)).

```ruby
set_webhook_url(url) # => true
```

```ruby
client.user.set_webhook_url("https://example.com/onlinesim-hook")
```

Errors: `ApiError` `VALIDATION_ERROR` for an invalid URL; `message` holds the server's field messages.

## clear_webhook_url

Remove the webhook URL, also from operations in progress.

```ruby
clear_webhook_url # => true
```

```ruby
client.user.clear_webhook_url
```

## webhook_logs

Webhook delivery log, newest first, 10 per page.

```ruby
webhook_logs(page = 1) # => paginator Hash
```

A log entry: `{"id", "user_id", "webhook_url", "type", "params", "status", "error", "created_at", "updated_at"}` — `type` is `receiving_sms` or `rent_sms`, `status` is `success`, `fail` or `pending`, `params` the payload that was sent.

```ruby
client.user.webhook_logs["data"].each do |log|
  puts log.values_at("created_at", "status", "error").join(" ")
end
```


# Webhooks

Set a URL with [`client.user.set_webhook_url`](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-ruby-api/user#set_webhook_url). For each SMS the server POSTs a JSON body to it: `webhook_type` `receiving_sms` for numbers, `rent_sms` for rents. Delivery attempts are listed by [`client.user.webhook_logs`](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-ruby-api/user#webhook_logs).

## parse_webhook

Parse an inbound webhook body from a JSON string or an already parsed `Hash` (string or symbol keys).

```ruby
OnlineSim.parse_webhook(payload) # => Hash
```

Lenient: numeric fields may arrive as strings, missing or malformed fields become `nil`, unknown fields are dropped. It raises `OnlineSim::Error` only when the input is not a JSON object.

```ruby
require "onlinesim"

# Rack app (config.ru): run WebhookApp
WebhookApp = lambda do |env|
  hook = OnlineSim.parse_webhook(env["rack.input"].read)
  puts "#{hook['operation_id']} #{hook['code']}" if hook["webhook_type"] == "receiving_sms"
  [200, { "content-type" => "text/plain" }, ["ok"]]
end
```

## Payload fields

| Field          | Type                                   | Description                                                                                                                  |
| -------------- | -------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `webhook_type` | `"receiving_sms"`, `"rent_sms"`, `nil` | Kind of operation.                                                                                                           |
| `operation_id` | `Integer`, `nil`                       | `tzid` of the operation or rent.                                                                                             |
| `user_id`      | `Integer`, `nil`                       | Account id.                                                                                                                  |
| `country_code` | `Integer`, `nil`                       | Country code of the number.                                                                                                  |
| `number`       | `String`, `nil`                        | Numbers: `+` and the full number (`+79001234567`), or `hidden`. Rent: the full number in digits without `+` (`79001234567`). |
| `sender`       | `String`, `nil`                        | Sender of the SMS, e.g. `VK`.                                                                                                |
| `message`      | `String`, `nil`                        | Full SMS text.                                                                                                               |
| `code`         | `String`, `nil`                        | Code extracted from the SMS; `""` when none was found.                                                                       |
| `time_start`   | `String`, `nil`                        | Numbers: when the operation was ordered. Rent: when the SMS arrived. `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`.                                  |
| `time_left`    | `Integer`, `nil`                       | Time left: seconds for numbers, minutes for rent.                                                                            |
